note: #547 phase B, BROWSER-SIDE half. Every mutation here only changes what the page serves AFTER `npm run build` and a server restart, which scripts/mutation-test.sh deliberately refuses to guess at. Run each one as: apply -> npm run build -> restart the instance -> confirm the CONTROL below actually changed in the served HTML -> then run the spec. Skipping the control check is how a stale server produced a false all-clear during this iteration. The three marked SURVIVOR passed the suite as first written and were found by the Ottomate code verifier.
